name: Crossroads
district: Prologue (the Town Hall war room), the Public Library, the School District, the Community Clinic, Fire & EMS Dispatch, the Regional Airport and the Compact-wide incident (the finale), with New Game+ on the other track
blurb: A week after Town Hall, two offers: run the region’s incident response programme as IR manager, or join the outside firm as principal DFIR consultant. Choose once; the Public Library is first, then the School District, the Community Clinic, Fire & EMS Dispatch, the Regional Airport and, at the end, the Compact-wide incident. After the ending, New Game+ opens the other track on a fresh save.
